name: XML
desc: Represents an XML element. Load with loadXML() or parseXML(). Access children and attributes by name.
syntax:
XML xml = loadXML("data.xml")
XML* child = xml.getChild("element")

methods.name: getName()
methods.desc: Returns the name of the element

methods.name: getContent()
methods.desc: Returns the text content of the element

methods.name: getAttribute(std::string k)
methods.desc: Returns the value of an attribute

methods.name: getChildren(std::string name)
methods.desc: Returns all children with given tag name
